name: Watashi no Otomodachi
source:
In a village surrounded by a forest, a girl ignores her mom's warning and goes out into the forest to play.

"What do you wanna do today?"

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130129093059/http://o0escapism0o.web.fc2.com/myf/top.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
在一个被森林包围的村庄里，一个女孩不顾妈妈的警告，到森林里去玩耍。

“你今天想做什么？”

[翻译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130129093059/http://o0escapism0o.web.fc2.com/myf/top.html]官网[/url]]
